summary: Apply-flow feature (A+B+C+D) tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (offer_link/offer_source on detail, offer-link validation 400 + persistence, apply-opened only when a_postuler, apply_pending in list, apply-not-yet clears, applied sets postule+applied_at+timeline and clears pending, cross-member 404 on all 5 endpoints, unauth 401). _offer_link unit-checked for offer_url and first URL in offer_text (trailing .,; and parenthesis stripped). Frontend: apply-bar + 3 steps, open-offer opens original Workday URL in new tab, host 'desjardins.wd10.myworkdayjobs.com · via workday', copy link puts URL in clipboard + toast, ask dialog after return (visibilitychange), 'later' suppresses dialog on reload within session and dialog reappears after sessionStorage cleared, 'Pas encore' clears pending (no dialog after reload), 'Oui' -> select shows Postulé, apply-done 'Postulé le …', hint, button becomes 'Revoir l'offre', .ics downloads (CO-xxx_relance.ics, DTSTART J+7, offer URL in description). No-link pack shows apply-add-link; invalid URL toast; valid URL saved and persisted after reload; direct 'J'ai postulé' works. Dashboard row-apply-pending badge 'Candidature à confirmer' shown. All test data restored (3 apps back to a_postuler, offer_link/applied_at/apply_opened_at unset).

minor.issue: No status guard: calling it on an app at 'entrevue'/'offre' downgrades it to 'postule' and overwrites applied_at. UI only shows the button when a_postuler, but API should ignore/409 when already past a_postuler.

Manual status change via select to 'postule' does not set applied_at (UI shows 'Candidature envoyée' without date) and reverting to a_postuler leaves stale applied_at / apply_opened_at (old pending could resurface).

ui_bugs.issue: J+7 date computed from Date.now() at download time, not from a.applied_at; downloading on a later visit gives wrong reminder date and the description 'envoyée il y a 7 jours' becomes inaccurate. Also uses UTC toISOString date (can be off by one in evening Montreal time). Lines not folded at 75 octets (most clients tolerate).
Each click on apply-open-offer-btn adds a new visibilitychange listener (removed only after firing) — harmless but could stack; listener not cleaned on unmount.

issues: 'Plus' action next to 'Préparer l'entrevue' is clipped at right edge (pre-existing header row, not apply bar).

action_items: Optional: guard POST /applied (only when pipeline_status == a_postuler) to avoid downgrading later stages
Optional: set applied_at when status manually changed to 'postule'; unset apply_opened_at on manual status changes
Optional: base .ics reminder date on applied_at (local date) instead of now
critical_code_review_comments: ApplyBar `applied = a.pipeline_status !== 'a_postuler'` treats null/undefined pipeline_status as applied — fine if always set at creation; verify legacy docs.
Headless note: page.bring_to_front() does not fire visibilitychange in Playwright; dialog verified by dispatching the event manually (real browsers fire it on tab return).
seed_data_creation: None persisted; temporary changes on apps 9cdcacbd, abea3957, a793f26d were reverted.
